mobile.doctor.daemon.not_installed: The phone service is not set up on this computer, so it is not running.
mobile.doctor.daemon.not_running: The phone service is set up but not running; the phone app shows this computer as asleep until it starts.
mobile.doctor.daemon.ok: The phone service is running and answered in {ms} ms.
mobile.doctor.daemon.slow: The phone service is running but took {ms} ms to answer, which the phone app may show as not answering.
mobile.doctor.daemon.gate_open: The phone service answered without asking for its password: the phone portal is unprotected.
mobile.doctor.files.ok: The phone service has {open} of {limit} files open.
mobile.doctor.files.near: The phone service has {open} of {limit} files open, close to its limit, so new phone connections and database opens can fail.
mobile.doctor.files.unknown: The phone service's open files could not be counted on this computer.
mobile.doctor.logs.clean: No out-of-files or database-open errors in the last day of logs.
mobile.doctor.logs.errors: The last day of logs shows out-of-files errors ({emfile}) and database-open errors ({sqlite}); the phone service may be running out of files.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.not_configured: Phone access through Radient is not set up on this computer.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.ok: The tunnel is set up and its connector is {state}.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.problem: The tunnel is set up but its connector is {state} ({reason}).
mobile.doctor.tunnel.single: This Radient account has one tunnel for this computer.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.duplicates: This Radient account has {count} tunnels for this computer; the phone app may be connecting to an old one.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.list_unchecked: The account's tunnel list could not be read, so duplicate tunnels were not checked.
mobile.doctor.files.not_running: The phone service is not running, so it has no open files to count.
mobile.doctor.daemon.not_answering: The phone service is running but not answering; the phone app shows this computer as not answering. It may have run out of files.
